reviewSamples.author: Photo of Alejandro
reviewSamples.text: Hired palm cleaning to clean both my yards. They did an amazing job, my yards look brand new. They also did my fence, now it looks like a new fence was installed when it’s just the same old one, but palm cleaning services brought it back to life. I will definitely contact them again for all of the other services they provide.
